# MinHook Dependency

Unmodified MinHook v1.3.4 is vendored from
https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook/releases/tag/v1.3.4 .

The source archive SHA-256 is
`172708123DAA0C98D20D3A980B16A50BE14AF243DC95DEE6F79C24193AD010E4`.
Keep `minhook/LICENSE.txt` in source and binary distributions.

The speed clock uses MinHook for Windows instruction relocation and hook
installation. It is independent of game build offsets. Its continuous affine
clock model follows the same timing principle as Cheat Engine's published
speedhack implementation; no Cheat Engine source is bundled.
